bannerText: Orbit Poster: bài đã điền sẵn nguyên văn. Bấm Post trên OKX để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Remote config for Muse Orbit Poster. The extension fetches this file from GitHub on every poll (max 5 min cache). Changing orbitUrl, selectors or delays here applies automatically, no extension reinstall needed. Only core logic changes need a new extension version.
